snippet.title: ForksandDaggers Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Forks & Daggers is a social, funny, chaotic party game where everything is a weapon. Find the traior or choose to become a traitor, and eliminate your friends!Throw bottles, mugs, or use a frying pan, stick as a weapon, trigger environmental traps, and secretly grab the scroll and convert to Dagger. Get knocked out? Return as a cat or rat and keep messing with everyone. Grab your friends, trust no one, and cause beautiful chaos.

Add to Wishlist on Steam!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/35...

Music: “Mozart - Rondo Alla Turca - Sonata No. 11, A major, KV 331 - Arranged for Strings” by Gregor Quendel / Classicals.de 
Source: https://www.classicals.de
